notes: CMH ETO-OB chronology: arrived on the Continent 18 July 1944. Location is the nearest listed CP at Le-Mesnil-St-Martin, Manche (CMH ETO-OB), 1 days after the row date; the division position on the day is not stated. Location caveat: the CMH CP name "Mesnil-St-Martin" could not be resolved to a Manche commune with certainty. The Nominatim match used before (about 49.0, -1.29, near Percy) lies roughly 50 km from the landing beaches and is inconsistent with the later CP at Méautis (17-18 July) and with a unit that had just landed at Utah Beach (Coutances was not taken until 28 July); the point is therefore unreliable and is kept only as a very wide inferred point. The unit was in the Cotentin beachhead assembly area (a 37th Tank Battalion report puts the division assembly area in use on 12 July).
